newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inflation tame despite tight labor -- Lindsey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inflation tame despite tight labor -- Lindsey.

text.p: U.S. inflation is under control despite pressures from the labor market, Federal Reserve Board Governor Lawrence Lindsey said.
"Prices seem quite well-contained," Lindsey said in an interview on the financial cable network CNBC.
So far, rising wages have not accelerated overall price growth, the outgoing Fed policymaker said.
"Clearly the labor market is quite tight," he said. "We're seeing upward pressure on wages."
But prices of most goods and services, particularly those not connected with food or energy, remain stable, Lindsey said.
"By and large we're doing pretty well," he said.
